'and he sent messengers to him saying: what have I to do with you, king of Judah? not against you this day, but against the house of my war... refrain from the god who is with me, lest he destroy you' (2 Chr 35:21)
what is 'the god who is with me'? Rav Yehuda said in Rav's name: this is idolatry
he [Josiah] said: since he trusts in idolatry, I can overcome him
'and the archers shot at King Josiah... for I am sorely wounded' (2 Chr 35:23) -- what is 'sorely wounded'? Rav Yehuda said in Rav's name: it teaches that they made his whole body like a sieve
why was Josiah punished? because he should have consulted Jeremiah and did not
(entertained) what 'sword' [in 'and a sword shall not pass through your land', Lev 26:6]? if you say a sword that is not of peace
but it is written: 'and I will give peace in the land' (Lev 26:6)
'and a sword shall not pass through your land' (Lev 26:6) -- rather, even [a sword] of peace
but he did not know that his generation was not seemly [worthy]
Jeremiah [seeing his lips move] said: perhaps, Heaven forbid, he is saying something improper because of his pain
he bent down and heard him justifying the judgment upon himself
Josiah: 'the Lord is righteous, for I rebelled against His word' (Lam 1:18)
at that hour Jeremiah opened over him: 'the breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord' (Lam 4:20)
